releases.notes:
- Fixed: crash on startup with Minecraft 26.2 (issue #2).
- Fixed: the creative inventory no longer flashes in the top-left corner when you open it (issue #3).
- New: Minecraft 26.3 support - one jar per version (26.2 and 26.3).
- The player model in the inventory now follows the panel smoothly and fades with it.
- Fade styles now fade the slot items too, not only the panel and text.
- Hover and clicks match what you see while a screen is animating; a closing screen ignores clicks.
- The animation now starts on the first rendered frame, so a slow first frame no longer eats it.
- New: Reduced motion switch - screens only fade, all movement effects go back to vanilla.
- New: per-screen deny list ("Screens" tab) - never animate the screens you pick.
- New: the dim and blur behind menus fade in and out with the screen; slot highlight cross-fades between slots.
- Faster item-glide tracking (no per-frame item copies); allocation-free hot paths.
- Auto-yields only the overlapping feature when Smooth Swapping, Smooth Scrolling or Smooth Hover is installed.


---
**Pre-release.** Passed automated in-game tests (client gametests with a full mixin audit + a launch of every built jar into a world) on each listed Minecraft version. A hands-on playtest is still pending — please report anything odd in Issues.

releases.notes:
Smooth, fully customizable animations for Minecraft **26.1.2**'s instant GUI — Fabric.

## Features
- **Chat** — new messages slide up smoothly instead of popping in.
- **Item slots** — stacks glide between slots (configurable easing) instead of teleporting.
- **Creative menu** — pixel-smooth scrolling instead of row-paging.
- **Hotbar** — the selector slides between slots.
- **Inventory & pause / menus** — fade & scale on open and close, each with its own style, speed and easing curve.
- **Menu→menu transitions** — **Slide / Zoom / Fade / Swap**, selectable, when navigating between screens (e.g. Pause → Options).
- **Smooth list scrolling** — every vanilla-list screen (Options, Mod Menu, Cloth Config, and any mod that reuses the vanilla list) scrolls eased instead of snapping. No mod is hardcoded.
- **Flat settings screen** — a Sodium-style tabbed GUI (General / Inventory / Game menu / Chat); every knob is live and the screen animates itself.
- A master switch freezes everything back to vanilla.

Vanilla GUIs keep their exact look — only their motion is animated. The mod's own settings screen uses the Limucc flat style.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.1.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.2+**
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu (optional, to reach the settings screen)

## Install
Drop `animated-gui-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods/` folder alongside Fabric API.
